newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ABN Amro signs agreement with Bulgarian bank.
newsitem.headline: ABN Amro signs agreement with Bulgarian bank.

text.p: Dutch ABN Amro Bank has agreed to provide technical advice to Bulgaria's state-owned Biochim Bank under a twinning agreement signed on Thursday.

"The twinning agreement will enable Biochim bank to improve its structure and services through technical assistance provided by ABN Amro Bank," Biochim executive director Vladimir Georgiev told reporters.

The agreement covers a 24-month period and includes the fields of budgeting and marketing, internal audit and control, branch network, information technology, liquidity and credit portfolio management.
Biochim bank was set up through a merger of three smaller institutions in August last year and is one of the country's biggest banks with assets totalling some 126 billion levs.
The state holds over 99 percent of Biochim's 16.8 billion lev capital through a Bank Consolidation Company which manages state equity in local commercial banks.
